| description = Spawned from [[Maligar]] during the [[Bard Epic Quest]]. Harm Touches initially for approximately 451 damage. Surrounded by 4 lower-level guards. **Serious under-con. His regenerative abilities are incredible. Do not understimate this NPC** 

Equip your wind instrument, then Charm [[Maligar]] with [[Solon's Bewitching Bravura]] Now pull him back away from his guards.  Turn in the Note to him while charmed to spawn Maligar's Enraged Doppleganger.

At this point if you have a better geared higher level class parked there you can use [[Song of Twilight]] to mez and hold him while you camp out to your alt, I had no trouble killing him with 60 druid (no harmony required) 2/6/25

<p> 7/23/2020 -- Soloed by a 60 [[Wizard]] (helping a friend). [[Atol's Spectral Shackles]] lands easily. Alternate [[Sunstrike]] / [[Ice Spear of Solist]] til dead.</p> <p> 2/14/2021 -- Able to spawn with bard, mez with twilight, switch to 60 wizard to kill w/o despawning </p>
